review_evidence: README identifies SciLean as a Lean scientific-computing library covering differential equations, optimization, machine learning, and differentiable programming; inspection found 568 Lean files and over 5,000 declaration-shaped items.

Test/ contains actual mathematical constructions and theorems such as tmap_fst_id/tmap_snd_id and sqrtBabylonianLimit, while examples/ contains complete models including ODE/PDE, optimization, manifold, FFT, and probabilistic examples.
Because formal examples and regression files carry distinct statements and constructions, no path-prefix exclusion of Test/ or examples/ is lossless under the corpus inclusion rule.
summary: Retain SciLean library, examples, and tests because the non-core trees contain substantive scientific-computing definitions and theorem statements, so blanket test/example filtering would lose prior-art signal.
